# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| starting-profile | Profile A, B, C or D recorded at the top of the tracker, read from the live plant record | OD lead, local key user | Region, machines recorded and integrated share noted with the read date; Entry stage set from the profile |
| onboarding-path-tracker | `assets/onboarding-path.md`, filled | OD lead, local key user | One row per stage (1 to 8) with skill, artefact, role, evidence and status; Each stage has its artefact filed or an explicit reason it does not apply |
| plant-side-owner-per-lane | Owner roles in the tracker | OD lead | A plant-side owner is assigned for each lane the plant uses, or `⟨plant-side owner per lane⟩` is shown as open |
| wait-states | Status and evidence columns of the tracker | OD lead | Any stage that cannot start has its wait state recorded (investment approval, Cyber Security sign-off before go-live, decision on shared tooling); No stage is skipped |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| starting-profile | manual | OD lead |
| onboarding-path-tracker | structure of `assets/onboarding-path.md` | OD lead |
| plant-side-owner-per-lane | manual | OD lead |
| wait-states | manual | OD lead |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `know-sharepoint-export`, `dept-intake`, `mi-equipment`
- **Next:** dept-plant-diagnosis (tiering and roadmap when the plant enters scope), then the stage skills: mi-equipment, dept-intake, catalog-usecase, deploy-handover, know-training, and the routines metrics-scorecard, dept-risk, dept-retro.: `dept-plant-diagnosis`, `mi-equipment`, `dept-intake`, `catalog-usecase`, `deploy-handover`, `know-training`, `metrics-scorecard`, `dept-risk`, `dept-retro`
- **Stops here when:** the plant is not recorded (stage 1 is the precondition for every comparison), or the stage order would be changed to meet a date
- **Stops here when:** Record the wait state instead
- **Stops here when:** a machine is never connected to an external system without Cyber Security / OT sign-off
